title: Work IQ: agents upload files and content to Microsoft 365
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly describes the tenant policy as the only documented control that can gate Work IQ MCP writes. Microsoft also documents OAuth scopes that hide write paths from read-only applications. The roadmap details, policy navigation and consumption-billing statements are supported.
